regionalOrNationalSources: Ethio-NSDI is an official Space Science and Geospatial Institute geoportal and advertises WMS/WFS/REST capabilities, but the public resource listing did not expose an Irgalem parcel layer.
The e-Land viewer is explicitly operated by Addis Ababa City Administration Land Holding Registration and Information Agency; it is not evidence for Irgalem or Sidama coverage.
Federal land-administration material describes legal responsibilities and cadastral concepts but is not a city-specific open parcel source.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: No city or regional Irgalem registry/map/procedure source was identified in this attempt; national and Addis-specific material is insufficient for registryFound=true.

requestOutcomes: TLS-verified GET/search inspection reached https://ethionsdi.gov.et/ through public indexed content and confirmed the official geoportal's advertised WMS/WFS/REST functions and public resource area. A TLS-verified GET of https://eland.addiscadaster.gov.et/maps returned HTTP 200; its current HTML referenced the live Angular bundle, but the bundle request timed out during the bounded anonymous fetch. The viewer's stated institutional scope is Addis Ababa, so it was not queried for Irgalem parcel features. Direct curl to Ethio-NSDI failed TLS verification because the host presented a self-signed certificate; no certificate exception was used. Requests to candidate SNNPR and Sidama government hostnames failed DNS resolution. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or global TLS-disable was used.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Public indexed page confirms an official geospatial portal with public/authorized resource management and advertised OGC WMS/WFS plus REST API capabilities. No Irgalem parcel dataset, layer identifier, schema, CRS, or anonymous feature response was exposed by the inspected public content. Direct TLS request rejected the site's self-signed certificate; no exception used.
Public indexed listing was reachable in search results as 'All Resources', but no Irgalem-specific parcel resource or safe native-ID-plus-geometry response was identified.
